articles.title: OpenAI Microscope: ery significant layer and neuron of eight vision “model organisms” which are often studied in interpretability
articles.desc: We’re introducing OpenAI Microscope, a collection of visualizations of every significant layer and neuron of eight vision “model organisms” which are often studied in interpretability. Microscope makes it easier to analyze the features that form inside these neural networks, and we hope it will help the research community as we move towards understanding these complicated systems.
